title: Onion Bhaji
description: Thin-sliced onion bound in a spiced gram flour batter and fried in loose, craggy clusters. Makes about 12.
notes: Serve with mint chutney or tamarind chutney, while they are still crackling.

steps.text: Toss the sliced onions with the salt and leave until they soften and release their juice.
steps.tip: The onion juice is most of the liquid in the batter. Add water only after this.

steps.text: Add the gram flour, rice flour, cumin seeds, turmeric, chilli powder, green chilli, ginger, and cilantro and mix, adding the water a spoonful at a time, until the onions are just coated in a thick batter.
Drop loose, craggy spoonfuls into the hot oil and fry, turning, until deep golden and crisp.
steps.tip: Loose is right — the stray strands are the best part.

steps.text: Drain on a rack and serve hot.
